   - Impact: every `loadRegistry()` call blocks the renderer while the main process decrypts every stored model key. It runs many times per render.

   - Fix: load all config once into a renderer cache and write changes through async `invoke`. Memoize the registry and invalidate it on `nova-model-registry-updated`.

2. The whole job list is rewritten synchronously on every change (verified)
   - Impact: each add, replace or complete re-serializes every job and blocks the renderer on a SQLite write.
   - Evidence: [useWorkspaceJobs.ts:82](frontend/src/hooks/useWorkspaceJobs.ts:82) calls `saveJobs` inside the `setJobs` updater. [usePersistedSettings.ts:67](frontend/src/hooks/usePersistedSettings.ts:67) writes on every change.
   - Fix: save each job with async `records.put` into the existing `generation-jobs` namespace, or debounce writes (about 500 ms, flushed on `pagehide`).

3. Blocking main-process file I/O and an unfiltered request hook (verified)
   - Impact: large file reads, full-list fetches and backups freeze the main process. While it's busy, every renderer request waits in the hook and the sync calls from #1 stall.
   - Evidence: [file-store.js:97](desktop/storage/file-store.js:97) uses `readFileSync` and runs an UPDATE on every read. [ipc.js:58](desktop/ipc.js:58) adds an extra `Uint8Array` copy. [storage-service.js:180](desktop/storage/storage-service.js:180) `recordList` returns every row.    - Fix: stream files through `protocol.handle`, paginate lists, lazy-load reference images, and filter the hook to the backend origin.

4. The backend buffers and duplicates payloads (verified)
   - Impact: peak memory is roughly items × (request body + response text + parsed JSON + decoded image), with up to 50 items in flight. One 4K result is about 10–20 MB of base64.
   - Evidence: [server.js:129](backend/server.js:129) turns on streaming with `partial_images=1` by default. [server.js:1143](backend/server.js:1143) then buffers the whole stream with `response.text()` and throws the partial images away (:1128). Reference images are decoded again for each item and each fallback (:961). Concurrency is 50 (:23), and `taskRefImages` (:826) holds up to 20 pending tasks × 10 MB.
   - Fix: turn streaming off by default or parse it incrementally. Build each request body once per task. Set `NOVA_TASK_CONCURRENCY` to 4–8 in [backend-process.js](desktop/backend-process.js).

[backend-process.js:98](desktop/backend-process.js:98) the queue-status fetch has no timeout, so Quit from the tray can hang.
